title: Deterministic programs as learning programs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let the target be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the sign values, and let a deterministic query program query points of that cube and return an output of any type. Interpreting it as a learning program that makes membership queries yields a point-mass law concentrated on the deterministic run's output and cost.
hypotheses_covered: target function from the n-dimensional sign cube to sign values
